lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Kiko. The NSPC morning deadline is approaching rapidly. Is the publication portfolio ready?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Almost, Ma'am! We've retrieved all master assets. May I use the office computer to apply the final formatting touches?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Of course. Workstation is all yours.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Remember, Kiko: this portfolio represents everything I've taught you. Every tool has a job.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Center your big 18pt bold title. Italicize the subtitle so it looks clean and official.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Add Space Before on bold section headings so topics don't bleed together.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Bullets for your investigation points, and numbered steps for our action plan.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: When your formatting is sharp and disciplined, nobody can brush off your reporting. That's how we win NSPC.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Get it printed and bring it straight to my desk.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Yes, Ma'am! I won't let The Paragon down.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Assemble that Master Portfolio on the office computer. Clean fonts, proper spacing, and the right lists.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Let me know the second it's printed.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Let's inspect the master proof for the 2026 NSPC Submission.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Incredible work, Kiko. You have mastered every principle of publication formatting.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: The Master Portfolio is unified, disciplined, and ready for Mr. Reyes' final submission tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Double check all titles, alignments, and lists before sending the final print job.
